title: RTL text odp 001
notes: real RTL slide: the Arabic sentence هذا اختبار للنص العربي في ملف الثبوت. plus three Hebrew bullets (strings shared with the odt rtl-text fixtures) ride the named paragraph style GP RTL (style:paragraph-properties fo:text-align="end" + style:text-properties fo:direction="rtl"); the second bullet embeds an LTR run via text:span with the GP LTR character style (fo:direction="ltr") holding "hello stichos"; the Hebrew list is a real text:list > text:list-item chain inside the presentation:body frame, the plain deck title sits in the title frame. Honest caveats: ODF has no dedicated paragraph-bidi attribute, direction rides on fo:direction and end-alignment on fo:text-align="end" (mirror logic differs left-to-right), and bidi reordering is performed by the renderer's bidi engine, not stored as layout — LibreOffice was not run here. Reference text is the exact inserted strings in logical order. The normative counters read draw:frame=2.
